verdict.rationale: doola's docs tell partners to build and test against sandbox first. They state that sandbox keys never trigger real state filings or charges. Two sandbox-only endpoints complete the formation and EIN milestones on demand and fire the real webhooks, so the whole integration can be exercised without production effects. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that sandbox data is isolated from production (e.g., separate environments or base URLs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox behavior.
